title: Give each part of support a clear owner.
intro: Build a helpdesk around the work between a new request and a useful resolution. Explore ticket handling, access coordination, knowledge maintenance and quality support, then choose the responsibilities that fit your queue.
caption: From a well-described ticket to an accepted handoff.
groups: Map the inboxes, chat channels and ticket queues that need attention. Define urgent categories, required information and the response an agent can give immediately.
Look for missing screenshots, unclear ownership and repeated follow-up. Choose the role that can collect the evidence and give the next team a usable record.
Write the acceptance criteria for resolution, escalation and customer updates. Your technical owners retain system changes and access approvals outside the agreed procedure.
